Generate a quality check log for placeholder replacements (developer utility)

generate_quality_check.Rd

Internal developer-facing utility used by replace_placeholders() to compare current placeholder code content against the latest logged state (CSV) and record change metadata. Optionally generates an HTML report (Quarto + reactable) from the same CSV.

Usage

generate_quality_check(
  code_content,
  markdown_file,
  placeholder_prefix = "placeholder_content",
  validation_path = "validation",
  log_file = "quality_log.csv",
  html_file = "validation.html"
)

Arguments

code_content

A named list of content specifications and scalars, typically from placeholder_map().

markdown_file

Path to the markdown file used to extract nearby context for placeholders.

placeholder_prefix

Prefix used for placeholders in the markdown. Defaults to "placeholder_content".

validation_path

Directory where outputs are saved (CSV, HTML). Defaults to "validation".

log_file

CSV log file name (within validation_path) to be generated and to read (if already exists). If NULL the log is not generated. Defaults to "quality_log.csv".

html_file

HTML report file name (within validation_path) to be generated. If this already exists it will be overwritten. If NULL the report is not generated. Default: "validation.html".

Value

Invisibly returns the current validation data frame (including change flags).
